instruction: Normal Bake High → Low `init_file/hi_low.blend` contains two mesh objects: • `HighPoly` — a subdivided, noise-displaced cube with clear surface detail. • `LowPoly` — a slightly larger cage cube that encloses HighPoly. It is UV-unwrapped with a Smart UV projection and carries a material `LowPolyMat` whose Image Texture node references a blank 1024×1024 image datablock called `BakeNormal`. That Image Texture node is already selected and set as the material's active node so bake operations target it. The render engine is Cycles (CPU). Your task is to bake a tangent-space normal map from `HighPoly` onto `LowPoly` using Cycles “selected-to-active” baking, then save the baked image to `output/normal_bake.png`. ## Required steps 1. Deselect everything, then select `HighPoly`, then select `LowPoly` and make `LowPoly` the ACTIVE object (Ctrl-click semantics: `lowpoly.select_set(True); bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = lowpoly`). 2. Ensure the Image Texture node referencing `BakeNormal` on `LowPolyMat` is the active node. 3. Configure bake settings: - `scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'`, `scene.cycles.device = 'CPU'` - `scene.render.bake.use_selected_to_active = True` - `scene.render.bake.cage_extrusion = 0.08` - `scene.render.bake.normal_space = 'TANGENT'` 4. Run the bake with `bpy.ops.object.bake(type='NORMAL', use_selected_to_active=True, cage_extrusion=0.08, normal_space='TANGENT')`. 5. Save the `BakeNormal` image to `output/normal_bake.png` (`image.filepath_raw = <abs_path>; image.file_format = 'PNG'; image.save()`). 1. Output PNG exists at `output/normal_bake.png`. 2. The image is exactly 1024×1024. 3. Mean of the B channel ≥ 0.80 (tangent-space normals point mostly outward, B ≈ 1). 4. Mean of the R channel is in [0.40, 0.60] (centered around 0.5). 5. Standard deviation of the R channel ≥ 0.03 (HighPoly detail was captured). 6. Mean of the G channel is in [0.40, 0.60]. 7. Standard deviation of the G channel ≥ 0.03. 8. At least 95% of pixels have B > 100/255. Bake in background mode requires: the LowPoly object to be the active, selected object with HighPoly also selected; HighPoly must fit inside LowPoly plus the cage extrusion; `LowPoly` must have a UV layer; and the Image Texture node referencing `BakeNormal` must be the active node on the material's node tree.
source: Cignoni, Montani, Scopigno 1998 — "A general method for preserving attribute values on simplified meshes", IEEE Visualization
